text: こくばんに　かかれてる　こと　ちゃんと　みて！

structure.jp: こくばんに　かかれてる　こと
structure.en: what is written on the blackboard

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: かく 'write' becomes かかれる 'be written', so the thing is on the receiving end. てる is the short spoken form of ている and shows the writing is still there. かかれてる = 'is written'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こくばんに　かかれてる　こと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a word describes that word. こくばんに かかれてる こと = 'the things that are written on the blackboard'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て with nothing after it is a casual way to ask someone to do something. みて = 'look!'.
